part1_question.detail_prompt: If yes or partial, specify the tool or technology in use.

questions.text: How frequently are access permissions reviewed?
What process triggers immediate credential revocation?
How are identities proofed and bound to credentials?
What training is provided to personnel on cybersecurity risks?
How are data-at-rest and data-in-transit protected?
questions.help_text: Explain encryption and access control measures

questions.text: What measures are in place to protect networks from unauthorized access?
questions.help_text: Describe network segmentation and firewall rules

maturity_guide.mature: Configuration management practices are well-established, and access permissions are regularly reviewed and updated. Identities are properly proofed and bound to credentials, and data-at-rest and data-in-transit are protected through encryption and access control measures. Personnel are provided with regular security awareness training, and networks are protected through segmentation and firewall rules.
maturity_guide.partial: Configuration management practices are partially established, and access permissions are occasionally reviewed. Identities are partially proofed and bound to credentials, and data-at-rest and data-in-transit are partially protected. Personnel may receive some security awareness training, but it is not regular or comprehensive.
maturity_guide.critical_gap: The absence of configuration management practices, identity proofing, and data protection measures leaves the organization vulnerable to unauthorized access, data breaches, and other cyber threats.

red_flags.critical_gap: Lack of regular security awareness training for personnel
red_flags.recommended_action: Develop and implement a comprehensive security awareness program for all personnel

red_flags.critical_gap: Inadequate protection of data-at-rest and data-in-transit
red_flags.recommended_action: Implement encryption and access control measures to protect sensitive data

red_flags.critical_gap: Insufficient network segmentation and firewall rules
red_flags.recommended_action: Conduct a network segmentation and firewall rule review to ensure adequate protection

red_flags.critical_gap: Inadequate identity proofing and binding to credentials
red_flags.recommended_action: Develop and implement an identity proofing procedure to ensure proper binding of identities to credentials
